method: Extract StarMapObject records whose paths/names identify Lagrange points and children.
notes: This does not use HPP_Lagrange_A/B/etc. provider presets.
This extracts actual starmap child records such as Pyro1_L1_01 and Stanton1_L1_01.
CIG uses the typo 'Enterance' in some record names; this script preserves isEntrance=true for both Enterance and Entrance.
If a system has no records here, ref_index.json does not expose Lagrange children for that system.
